evidence.title: GitHub - sysadminsmedia/homebox: A continuation of HomeBox the inventory and organization system built for the Home User · GitHub

name: HomeBox
summary: Self-hosted home inventory app: items, locations, tags, custom fields, photos, warranties and maintenance tracking.
description: An inventory and organization system for the home, written in Go with an embedded web UI and SQLite so it runs as a single small container (under 50 MB idle memory). Items are organized by categories, locations and tags with custom fields; it adds search, image upload, document and warranty storage, purchase price and maintenance schedules, and a responsive interface for desktop, tablet and phone. Docker Compose quick start, hosted demo instances, community translations via Weblate.
contains: items organized by categories, locations and tags, plus custom fields
image upload and document/warranty tracking per item
purchase date, price and maintenance schedule tracking
Go backend with SQLite and an embedded web UI; under 50 MB idle memory
single container with Docker Compose quick start; rootless and hardened images
hosted demo and nightly demo instances; translations via Weblate
